description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
.
1) If almost all of Revelation is written in symbols, why do we interpret the vials as literal.  Because the churches, trumpets, and seals all cover the same time period, how do we know that the bowls don’t cover these same periods?
.
2) "Was the devil and his angels cast out of heaven before the biblical creation of the Earth or during the creation of the earth or immediately after the creation of the earth?
I wish to also ask emphatically that has our been recreated again? Because according to the Genesis account of creation, there was some already existing matter.
Can we connect that to prehistoric events of the dinosaurs because most of them predate the existence of the first man Adam?"
. 
.
